statement: Altitude (framing) reflection is a first-class, automatically-triggered part of the Quest workflow: the solve.js run loop fires an altitude reflection on coupled-oscillation and on a coarse cadence (distinct from the 5-attempt micro reflection), recorded as a kind:'altitude' EVENT_REFLECTION with a frame-questioning prompt (right-altitude / modeling-efficiency / arrangement / pivot-or-continue); on-demand via 'reflect --altitude'; steering defines it and sanctions EXHAUST-and-pivot on a structural insight; capture-as-finding|epic|system-theory is required; packs regenerated, reflection tests green, and the change is subagent-verified.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
